analysis.noRemediationReason: No proved contract-preserving ordering/timing change makes the R147 sample complete. Ignoring a failed FD, mixing rounds or extending retries would violate the request. Preserve fail-closed algorithm and HOLD.
analysis.nextMinimumDecision: Before R149, obtain explicit approval for narrowly bounded observation of the actual FD-changing caller/operation and round timing, or another specified collector design study. No automatic product execution; no permission to relax completeness/retry/time limits.
analysis.nextTypeLimit: nextType0 is used as absent sentinel, but local SDK also defines PROX_FDTYPE_ATALK=0. R147 zero is not independently conclusive absence/type classification. nextType-1 means no subsequent roster; nextType1 does not prove object identity.
analysis.sequentialScope: complete-round-sequential-v1 is a full successful roster/detail traversal, not an atomic live process snapshot. Same inode observations use within-round maxima; successful FD reuse reads the new object, not a retained old FD identity.
